name: Block Animations, Scroll & Motion Effects by ExtenderX
author: WPXERO

sections.description:
ExtenderX adds Gutenberg block animations and scroll effects to every block in the Block Editor — core WordPress blocks and third-party block libraries alike. No replacement blocks. No shortcodes. Open the block sidebar, pick an animation preset, and publish.

Animate blocks on scroll with entrance animations, add continuous floating motion, apply 3D tilt on hover, control device visibility, add tooltips, and wrap blocks with wrapper links — all from a single ExtenderX panel inside Gutenberg.

Why Use ExtenderX for Block Animations?

Most animation plugins only work with their own blocks. ExtenderX extends the blocks you already use — including Kadence Blocks, Spectra, Stackable, Essential Blocks, Ultimate Blocks, Ghostkit, Greenshift, Otter Blocks, and more.

  • 6 animation & interaction types in one block sidebar panel
  • Scroll-triggered entrance animations with duration, delay, and easing controls
  • No coding required — configure everything visually in the editor
  • Conditional asset loading — animation scripts load only when a block uses them
  • Works with any theme — no page builder lock-in

Ready for advanced motion? Upgrade to Pro for parallax, custom CSS/JS per block, seasonal effects, and marketing tools.

How Block Animations Work

  1. Activate ExtenderX and enable Gutenberg Block Extensions from the dashboard.
  2. Edit any page or post in the Block Editor.
  3. Select a block and open the right sidebar.
  4. Open the ExtenderX panel and choose entrance, floating, tilt, visibility, tooltip, or wrapper link settings.

Your animations appear on the frontend immediately after publishing.

Gutenberg Block Animations (Free)

✅ Entrance Animations (Scroll Effects)
Make blocks animate on scroll with fade in, slide up, zoom in, flip, bounce, and more. Customize duration, delay, and easing. Animations trigger when blocks enter the viewport — perfect for landing pages, portfolios, and storytelling layouts.

✅ Floating Animations
Add subtle, continuous floating motion to any block. Ideal for hero sections, testimonials, and promotional banners.
Note: Floating animations do not run simultaneously with Entrance or Tilt on the same block.

✅ 3D Tilt Effect
Blocks respond to cursor movement with GPU-accelerated 3D tilt powered by VanillaTilt.js. Great for cards, images, pricing tables, and portfolio items.

✅ Responsive Visibility Control
Show or hide any block on desktop, tablet, or mobile independently using clean CSS — no duplicate content required.

✅ Tooltips
Add hover tooltips to any Gutenberg block powered by Tippy.js for accessible, smooth rendering.

✅ Wrapper Links
Turn any Gutenberg block into a clickable link — wrap images, groups, columns, and cards with a custom URL.

Block Library Compatibility

ExtenderX extends the Gutenberg editor itself, not individual block plugins. Tested with:

  • Kadence Blocks
  • Spectra (UAG)
  • Stackable
  • Essential Blocks
  • Ultimate Blocks
  • Ghostkit
  • Gutenverse
  • GutenKit
  • Otter Blocks
  • Greenshift
  • CoBlocks
  • GenerateBlocks
  • All core WordPress blocks

Bonus Site Tools (Also Included Free)

ExtenderX is more than block animations — it bundles a full suite of optional site-wide tools you can toggle from one dashboard, replacing several single-purpose plugins:

Dark Mode & Light Mode Toggle — visitor-facing dark mode powered by DarkReader, plus a light-mode toggle. Works with any theme, no configuration.

Maintenance Mode & Coming Soon Page — put your site behind a maintenance screen or launch a coming-soon page with a click, while you keep working in the dashboard.

Insert Headers & Footers + Custom Code Snippets — add HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to your site’s header (<head>), body, or footer without editing theme files. Manage reusable code snippets from one dashboard — perfect for Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, AdSense, and site verification tags.

Content Protection — disable right click, copy/paste, inspect element, and image drag to protect your content.

UI Enhancements — back to top button, sticky header, sticky footer, scroll progress bar, smart scroll (auto-hide header), and scrollspy navigation. Pro adds a matching scroll to bottom button.

Announcement Bar & Floating CTA — show a dismissible announcement / notification bar, a floating call-to-action button, and a CTA pulse animation to boost conversions.

Seasonal Effects — add a falling snow effect (Winter Snow), Autumn Leaves, or Falling Hearts overlay for holidays and special campaigns.

Appearance Polish — fade-in on page load and smooth CSS transitions site-wide.

Enable only what you need. Every feature loads conditionally — disabled tools add zero CSS or JavaScript to your pages.

Insert Headers and Footers + Code Snippets (Free)

ExtenderX includes a built-in headers and footers manager and custom code snippet library — no separate plugin required.

✅ Insert Header & Footer Code
Add scripts and meta tags to the <head>, after the opening <body>, or before the closing </body> — ideal for Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, site verification, and other third-party code.

✅ HTML, CSS & JavaScript Snippets
Create, organize, and toggle reusable code snippets from a clean dashboard table. Enable or disable each snippet instantly — your code stays saved even when switched off.

✅ Safe & Conditional Output
Snippets only run where you allow them. Custom PHP snippets, conditional display logic, and scheduling are available in ExtenderX Pro.

ExtenderX Pro

Pro unlocks advanced motion and site tools: site-wide Motion & Animations with scroll-linked parallax, scrub and sticky reveals (beta), parallax effects, custom CSS/JS per block, advanced scroll effects, PHP code snippets with conditional display logic and scheduling, scroll to bottom button, scrollbar styler, custom cursor effects, smooth scrolling (Lenis), 16+ seasonal & particle effects (Christmas lights, fireworks, fireflies, confetti, weather, and more), marketing tools (sticky WhatsApp button, global countdown banner), compliance modes (cookie consent, GDPR notice, age verification, exit intent), and advanced appearance modes (high contrast, reading mode, night shift, glassmorphism, preloader, skeleton loader).

View Pro pricing →

License & Disclaimer

This plugin is licensed under GPL v2 or later. No warranties are provided. You are free to modify and distribute it under the same license.
sections.installation:
1. Download & Install: Upload the extenderx folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or search for ExtenderX in the WordPress Plugin Repository and click Install Now.

  2. Activate the Plugin: Navigate to Plugins > Installed Plugins and click Activate next to ExtenderX.

  3. Enable Block Animations: After activation, open the ExtenderX Dashboard and ensure Gutenberg Blocks is enabled.

  4. Animate Your First Block: Edit any page, select a block, open the ExtenderX panel in the block sidebar, and choose an Entrance Animation preset.

  5. Publish — your block animation is live.
sections.faq:
How do I add scroll animations to Gutenberg blocks?

Open any page or post in the Gutenberg editor, select any block, and look for the ExtenderX panel in the right sidebar. Click Entrance Animation, choose a preset (fade in, slide up, zoom, flip, etc.), set duration and delay, and publish. Blocks animate when they scroll into view.

What is the difference between entrance, floating, and tilt animations?

Entrance animations trigger once when a block scrolls into the viewport. Floating animations add continuous subtle motion. 3D tilt responds to cursor movement. Only one motion type runs per block at a time — pick the effect that fits your design.

Does ExtenderX work with Kadence Blocks, Spectra, and Stackable?

Yes. ExtenderX extends the Gutenberg editor itself, so Kadence Blocks, Spectra, Stackable, Essential Blocks, Ultimate Blocks, Ghostkit, Greenshift, Otter Blocks, and other third-party block libraries automatically receive ExtenderX animation controls in the block sidebar.

Is ExtenderX compatible with all Gutenberg blocks?

Yes. Every core WordPress block and supported third-party block gets the ExtenderX panel with entrance, floating, tilt, visibility, tooltip, and wrapper link controls.

What is the 3D Tilt Effect and how do I use it?

Select any block in the editor, open the ExtenderX panel, and enable Tilt Effect. Adjust intensity and perspective. Blocks tilt in 3D as visitors move their cursor — powered by VanillaTilt.js.

How do I show or hide blocks on mobile, tablet, or desktop?

Select a block, open the ExtenderX panel, and use Visibility Control to toggle desktop, tablet, and mobile visibility independently.

Will ExtenderX slow down my website?

No. ExtenderX uses conditional asset loading — animation JavaScript and CSS load only when a block on the current page actually uses an ExtenderX effect. Unused features add zero overhead.

Do I need coding knowledge to use ExtenderX block animations?

Not at all. Select a block, open the ExtenderX panel, pick a preset, and publish. No CSS or JavaScript required.

Does ExtenderX work with third-party block libraries?

Absolutely. ExtenderX hooks into the block editor globally, so any registered Gutenberg block — core or third-party — receives animation controls automatically.

How do I enable dark mode on my WordPress website?

Navigate to ExtenderX > Site Enhancements > Appearance and toggle Dark Mode. Visitors get a floating toggle to switch themes. Dark mode uses the DarkReader engine and works with any theme.

How does content protection work in ExtenderX?

Enable Disable Right Click, Disable Copy Paste, Disable Inspect Element, and/or Disable Image Drag from Site Enhancements > Utility & Protection. Each layer can be toggled independently.

Can I disable right click on my WordPress site?

Yes. Go to ExtenderX > Site Enhancements > Utility & Protection and enable Disable Right Click.

How do I insert header and footer code in WordPress?

Go to ExtenderX > Custom Code, create a new snippet, paste your code, and choose where it loads — the header (<head>), body open (after <body>), or footer (before </body>). It’s perfect for Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, and site verification tags — no theme file editing required.

Can I add custom CSS, HTML, or JavaScript snippets?

Yes. The Custom Code screen lets you create and manage reusable HTML, CSS, and JavaScript snippets, each with its own on/off toggle. Disabled snippets stay saved but stop running. PHP snippets, conditional display logic, and scheduling are available in ExtenderX Pro.

How do I add a back to top button to my WordPress site?

Enable Back to Top from Site Enhancements > UI Enhancements. ExtenderX Pro also adds a matching Scroll to Bottom button with the same style presets.

How do I add a scroll progress bar?

Enable Scroll Progress Bar from Site Enhancements > UI Enhancements.

How does the Sticky Header feature work?

Enable Sticky Header from Site Enhancements > UI Enhancements. Your navigation stays fixed at the top of the viewport as visitors scroll. Sticky Header is included in the free version.

How do I add a falling snow effect to WordPress?

Go to ExtenderX > Site Enhancements > Seasonal Effects and enable Winter Snow for an animated falling-snow overlay. Autumn Leaves and Falling Hearts are also free. Additional seasonal and particle effects (Christmas lights, fireworks, fireflies, confetti, and more) are available in ExtenderX Pro.

How do I put my WordPress site in maintenance mode?

Enable Maintenance Mode from ExtenderX > Site Enhancements > Site Modes to show visitors a maintenance screen while you work. Both Maintenance Mode and a Coming Soon launch page are included free.

How do I create a coming soon page?

Enable Coming Soon Mode under Site Enhancements > Site Modes. ExtenderX displays a full-page coming-soon screen to visitors while administrators keep full access to the site. It’s free, with no separate plugin required.

How do I add an announcement bar or notification bar?

Enable Announcement Bar from Site Enhancements > Marketing. You can set the message, colors, position, and make it dismissible. A Floating CTA Button and CTA Pulse Animation are also included free.

Can I add Google Analytics or Tag Manager without editing theme files?

Yes. Open ExtenderX > Custom Code, create a snippet, paste your tracking code, and choose where it loads — the <head>, after the opening <body>, or before the closing </body>. It works for Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, AdSense, and site verification tags — no theme editing.

What is the difference between free and Pro?

The free version includes all 6 Gutenberg block extensions (entrance, floating, tilt, visibility, tooltip, wrapper link); the Insert Headers & Footers + HTML/CSS/JS code snippet manager; dark mode and light mode toggle; all 4 content protection features; back to top, sticky header, sticky footer, scroll progress bar, smart scroll and scrollspy; maintenance mode and coming soon page; announcement bar, floating CTA button and CTA pulse; and three seasonal effects (Winter Snow, Autumn Leaves, Falling Hearts). ExtenderX Pro unlocks parallax effects, custom CSS/JS per block, advanced scroll effects, PHP code snippets with conditional logic and scheduling, scroll to bottom button, scrollbar styler, custom cursor effects, smooth scrolling (Lenis), 16+ seasonal & particle effects, marketing tools (sticky WhatsApp button, countdown banner), compliance modes (cookie consent, GDPR, age verification, exit intent), and advanced appearance modes (high contrast, reading mode, night shift, glassmorphism, preloader, skeleton loader).

How do I upgrade to ExtenderX Pro?

Click Upgrade to Pro in the ExtenderX dashboard or visit wpxero.com/plugins/extenderx/pricing.

Does ExtenderX support RTL languages?

Yes. ExtenderX includes full RTL stylesheet support for Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu, and other RTL languages.

Can I add a WhatsApp chat button to my site?

Yes, with ExtenderX Pro. Enable Sticky WhatsApp Button from the Marketing section.

Does ExtenderX include cookie consent and GDPR compliance tools?

Yes, with ExtenderX Pro — Cookie Consent and GDPR Notice features are included.
